bottomLine: As a product, Bitnex Crestfort offers the expected setup and nothing that breaks. The issues sit in the published claims, and the claims are avoidable if you trade the minimum.
Our 4.7 reflects what the pages publish and what they skip. It is not a warning off - it is a reminder to trade the product, not the pitch.
